stem:
Our enemies continued to harass us in the fall of 1845. . . . They commenced burning houses, grain stacks, [and] driving off cattle. . . . The persecution became so general that for the sake of peace, ________________?_______________.

—Diary entry by a Mormon, 1846
instruction: Which phrase correctly completes the excerpt?

options.label: C
options.text: we asked the federal government for aid
